items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
New: Sixers player previews continue with Ariel Hukporti, part of the team’s batch of unproven potential solutions at backup center.

Hukporti has only logged 715 regular-season NBA minutes. How much do we actually know about his game?

www.phillyvoice.com/sixers-news-...

media.title: Sixers player preview: What kind of player is Ariel Hukporti going to be?
media.description: Can Ariel Hukporti emerge as the Sixers' primary backup center and pay off their investment in him? There is much unknown about a player with only 715 minutes of NBA experience.
